title: Arcadia
tagline: Arcadia, a warrior tale from Chiang Mai, explores a secret realm.
description: Arcadia is a chain game, which provides a basic mobile application experience with contract account and gasless playing. You can explore the secret world in your mobile, training and fighting with teams and monsters, get sword and gears. Also, you will get the nearest canteen's coupon with your points redeeming.
how_its_made:
AirAccount
ETHPaymaster
Hexagon (dart template)
Solidity/Foundry
Dart(Flutter)
Node
The most excited thing is we introduce real world business to the on-chain game.
It is a innovation in the game world.
You can play in the virtual world and get some reward from the real world. Amazing~
